admission.provider: oneDNN v3.13.2 experimental x64 BRGEMM ukernel

equivalence.candidate: the complete public HYLE Compute oneDNN-provider warm submit boundary
equivalence.peer: a noinline direct adapter over the identical pre-generated oneDNN BRGEMM ukernel
shared: one caller thread pinned to the same logical CPU
float32 M=32, K=4096, N=4096 row-major matrices
caller-owned 64-byte-aligned input, output and scratch storage
one sequential execute with hardware-context set and release
all allocation, descriptor construction, JIT generation and warmup outside measurement

equivalence.interpretation: This is a wrapper-tax non-inferiority row. It does not compare two different kernels, packing policies, layouts or threading strategies and cannot establish that oneDNN beats HYLE-native MatMul.

negative_space: decode M=1 and M=4 use the independently justified HYLE-native serial route and are not averaged into this result
parallel executor tiling is a separate execution-policy question and is not mixed into the serial wrapper-tax gate
f16, bf16, quantized weights, persistent packing, epilogues and graph partitioning require later finite cards
